text: Does the rash involve the palms and soles, and are there any lesions on the baby's mouth or genitals? I also need to know if the mother has had any recent fever or vaginal discharge during her pregnancy.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the pustular rash on an erythematous base sparing the palms and soles in a newborn, this presentation is highly characteristic of transient neonatal pustular melanosis. REQUEST IMAGES. Do the pustules rupture easily when pressed, leaving behind a collarette of scale?
